title: Şehzade Mosque

buildingCutout.basis: Native named Şehzade Mosque polygon covering the hall and forecourt.

terrainReference.basis: Original terrain at the northwestern open-court approach.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap Ottoman mosque building, inner courtyard and published chief tomb point.
mapIdentity.scope: The named native multipolygon fixes the tall prayer hall and paved forecourt. The mapped inner open area and orthogonal dimensions guide the arcade spacing. The independently recorded point of the central tomb and historic survey relationships locate the selected mausolea.

note: The Ottoman square prayer hall, 18.42 m central drum span and four surrounding half-domes follow municipality dimensions. Structural survey records a 37 m roof crown and 41.1 m minarets; the exact Qualla source shows the stacked stone and blue-gray lead masses, relief balconies and distinct fluted mausoleum dome.
